display.purpose: The name in the hero. One per page.

title.purpose: Project names in the ruled project list.

positioning.purpose: One-sentence positioning line under the name; 1.25rem below 768px, muted.

lede.purpose: Section ledes and project descriptions, muted, max 40rem.

body.purpose: Entry descriptions and bullet lists, max 40rem.

label.purpose: Chips, panel subtitles, diagram heading, node names.

data.purpose: Machine values only: commit SHA, region, protocols, dates.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The deploy panel only; the one lifted object.

shadows.name: trace-halo
shadows.purpose: Transient ring on a diagram node while the path trace passes; none at rest.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and press transitions on buttons, nav links and nodes.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One orchestrated load for the deploy panel header, rows and diagram. Transform only; content is visible without it. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: trace-node-hit
motion.purpose: Node border flashes to ink with a halo as the path trace passes.

motion.name: trace-wire-fill
motion.purpose: Wire fills with ink between nodes. Request lane plays once 900ms after load; deploy lane on pointer/focus entry. Never under reduced motion.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: The only looping motion: the live status dot. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Anchor navigation; only when motion is tolerated.

breakpoints.name: flow-compact
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: below this, diagram nodes and wires tighten.

narrative.overview:
czepiel.dev is built in the dev-tool product canon at the craft level of Vercel and Linear, played straight: a daylight surface of crisp neutrals, hairline structure, one cobalt accent and one green signal for live things. The product being sold is a person, and the proof is the page itself: a framed deploy panel with real commit, origin and pipeline data, and a small architecture diagram the visitor can interrogate. Everything else is set as calm, ruled editorial lists so the panel is the one object that reads as "product".

Density is moderate and recruiter-paced: large display type for the name, skim-paced section spacing (64px, 80px from 768px), and content held to readable measures (around 40rem for prose). Dark mode is not a separate design; it is the same token set re-valued under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, with no manual toggle. Motion is one orchestrated settle on load plus a one-shot path trace; nothing loops except the live status dot.

The system replaces an earlier terminal costume (monospace everywhere, `// HEADINGS`, hashtag badges, typewriter cursor), which the user retired. It also refuses the generic student template: a centred name over a grid of equal cards.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first neutrals with a system-following dark mode; every color is a CSS custom property re-valued per scheme.
One accent (cobalt) reserved for the action, focus, text selection and the pressed diagram node.
Green means live; amber means in progress; dashed means not yet.
Geist for all words, Geist Mono only for real data.
Structure from 1px hairlines and ruled lists; exactly one lifted object (the deploy panel).
Exponential ease-out on everything; full reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The Cobalt Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only where the visitor acts or where the system marks focus or selection: the primary button, the focus ring, `::selection`, the pressed node, the skip link. Headings, links, icons, chips and decoration never take it. Text links are ink with a hairline-strong underline.

rules.name: The Green Means Live Rule
rules.body: Green is spent only on things that are actually live right now (the site is online, the availability is open). Amber marks work in progress. These states never borrow each other's colour.

rules.name: The One Variable Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a `--c-*` custom property defined once for light and once for dark, exposed to Tailwind through `@theme`. Never hard-code a hex in markup; inline SVG uses `var(--c-*)` too.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for values a machine would print: hashes, regions, protocols, dates. Words inside a mono slot switch back to sans (e.g. "w produkcji" inside a date line, the pipeline row). Never set headings, labels or prose in mono.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading and label is sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Only the live "this page" panel casts a shadow, because it is the product demo. Lists, chips, buttons and nodes stay flat; if another surface wants elevation, it is probably a second card that should be a ruled row.

dos: **Do** keep cobalt to the primary button, focus ring, selection and the pressed node (The Cobalt Is a Verb Rule).
**Do** define every colour as a `--c-*` variable with both a light and a dark value; let dark mode follow `prefers-color-scheme`.
**Do** set real data (SHA, region, dates, protocols) in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, and everything else in Geist.
**Do** build repeating content as ruled rows with a metadata gutter, so the projects list can grow from two to four entries without a redesign.
**Do** show unfinished things honestly: a dashed pending control, a hollow amber ring for in-progress, a dashed muted ring for planned.
**Do** use inline SVG icons from one sprite, 24-unit viewBox, 2px round strokes, in `currentColor`.
**Do** keep content visible by default and animate only transform (settle from 6px below over 800ms, staggered 70ms), with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and 160ms for state changes.
**Do** give every button, nav control and diagram node at least 44px of height; inline text links are the exception.
donts: **Don't** bring back the terminal costume: monospace for prose, `// HEADINGS`, hashtag badges, typewriter text or blinking cursors.
**Don't** set the hero as a centred name over a grid of equal cards.
**Don't** add a second shadowed surface; the deploy panel is the one lifted object.
**Don't** use green for anything that is not live, or cobalt for decoration, headings or links.
**Don't** loop any animation other than the live status dot, and don't run settle, trace, pulse or smooth scrolling under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked labels above headings.
**Don't** load fonts, icons or scripts from third-party runtimes; Geist and Geist Mono are self-hosted.
